title: Fair value gap detection is now built into Kraken Desktop
content:
TL;DR




Kraken Desktop now includes a native fair value gap (FVG) indicator — add it from the Analysis sidebar and it identifies every imbalance on any candle chart, with no third-party script to import or maintain.



Built-in filtering removes low-quality gaps by default, and every zone is scored Low, Medium, or High based on five objective checks including higher-timeframe agreement and volume.
